name: Zee Entertainment Enterprises Ltd
tagline: Legacy Indian broadcaster (GEC + films) with a failed Sony merger behind it, still posting near-zero returns on capital and flat revenue five years running.
business_overview: Zee Entertainment Enterprises (NSE/BSE: ZEEL) operates general entertainment television channels (Zee TV, Zee Cinema, regional GECs) and a film/content production business (Zee Studios), plus a stake in the ZEE5 streaming platform. The company has been in a prolonged restructuring/turnaround phase since the collapsed 2024 merger with Sony Pictures Networks India, amid promoter-pledge and governance overhang from prior years.
fundamentals_table: P/E ~36x - expensive relative to earnings quality
fundamentals_narrative: Balance sheet is clean (near debt-free), but operating performance is weak on every profitability metric: ROCE ~2.7% and ROE ~2.4% are well below cost of capital, and topline has been essentially flat for five years as linear TV ad revenue erodes to OTT/digital and regional competitors gain share. The stock trades at a rich ~36x P/E despite this, which reflects turnaround hope (cost cuts, ZEE5 monetisation, possible partnership/M&A optionality) rather than demonstrated earnings power.
technical_read: Trading near the lower half of its 52-week range (Rs 68-122); no confirmed base or trend reversal established this pass.
